rag.text:
Test: TC-6166 — SPM - OKR - Updating Date custom field values across OKR views
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/SPM/OKR/TS-512 OKR - OKR module
Labels: spm-mikolaj-tc

Description:
This test verifies updating Date custom field values across all supported OKR views.

Covered areas:

* OKR Detail page
* Overview (inline editing)
* Side panel

Validation scope:

* Editing and saving Date custom field values
* Selecting and updating date values using date picker
* Verifying selected date is displayed correctly across all supported views
* Clearing Date custom field values
* Correct date picker and inline editing behavior across supported views

Steps:
1. *Preconditions:*

* Date custom field is created and assigned to Strategic Theme, Objective and Key Result (used-in)
* Existing OKRs contain predefined values for Date fields
* User has permissions to edit OKRs and custom field values
   Expected: 
2. Open OKR Overview of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-6166 SPM - OKR - Updating Date custom field values across OKR views
   Expected: Overview module is opened. The following OKRs are visible:

* Strategic theme 1
* Objective 1
* Key result 1
3. Navigate to Date field
   Expected: Date custom field is visible for Strategic Theme, Objective and Key Result.

The following text field values are displayed correctly for each item:

* Strategic Theme 1 - 05/01/2026
* Objective 1 - 04/30/2026
* Key Result 1 - 12/05/2026
4. Navigate to the Strategic theme Date custom field and click on field value
   Expected: Date picker calendar is displayed for the selected Date custom field
5. Click on Clear button
   Expected: Date picker closed and value disappear form Date field in Overview
6. Navigate to the Key result Date custom field and click on field value and change value
   Data: newValue: 01/20/27
   Expected: The new field value is saved and displayed correctly
7. Click on the grey area of the Key result row
   Expected: Side panel is opened on the right side and displays details of the selected Key result. Date field is visible with correct value.
8. Navigate to the Key result Date custom field and change the value
   Data: newValue: 02/01/27
   Expected: The new field value is saved and displayed correctly
9. Open Key result in the detail page and navigate to the Info section
   Expected: Detail page is opened. Date field is visible with correct value.
10. Navigate to the Key result Date custom field and change the value
   Data: newValue: 02/01/28
   Expected: The new field value is saved and displayed correctly
